unknownPolicy: Two named raw histories are expected to yield Elle empty-transaction-graph unknown while MoonBit independently finds consistent. They remain explicit coverage differences, not matching Boolean proofs.
exitConditions: All fifteen preregistered raw-adapter dispositions exactly match without consulting actual checker results.
Exactly eight real upstream check calls return the preregistered results with no hidden automatic graph and no search timeout; keep full raw EDN.
All eight separately executed MoonBit reports and their report verification pass frozen expectations, bound to the actual compiled core/capture bytes.
All source/raw-input/runtime/dependency hashes and versions are recorded and unchanged; every failure and outside/unknown case retained.
An independent reviewer audits the actual remote inputs, conversion and results before expansion.

nextStage.prerequisite: Successful actual small smoke and independent acceptance; preregister generator/seed/quotas and unknown/outside accounting before execution.
